name: Cancellation credit order/quote
expected: NetUnitPrice=15000, TotalPrice=-15000 (asset net x Qty=-1); CalculationStatus=CompletedWithPricing
actual: Force-reprice ERRORS at StampBaseFilter#1 (SF-Pricing-00006 / SF-BRE-00004). Fresh cancel QLI (CancelNetUnitPrice__c=15000, NetUnitPrice=null) stays NetUnitPrice=null, TotalPrice=0. CalculationStatus=PriceCalculationFailed. Reproduced on 3 independent records: prior quotes 0Q0WC000003FZ290AG (QLI 0QLWC000003kiab4AA) and 0Q0WC000003FZ3l0AG (QLI 0QLWC000003kicD4AQ), and fresh new quote 0Q0WC000003FoMA0A0 (QLI 0QLWC000003kySU4AY, CancelNetUnitPrice__c=15000). Cancel order 801WC00000m1DvgYAE (OI 802WC00000PYOG3YAP) also fails with same error. CONTROL PASS: prior quote 0Q0WC000003EQtl0AG (QLI 0QLWC000003jbhd4AA) with NetUnitPrice already=15000 reprices successfully to TotalPrice=-15000, confirming CancelLineCreditPosthook is functional when StampBaseFilter is cleared.
evidence: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FoMA0A0/view (fresh cancel QLI 0QLWC000003kySU4AY, CancelNetUnitPrice__c=15000, NetUnitPrice=null post-reprice); https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003EQtl0AG/view (control pass: NetUnitPrice=15000, TotalPrice=-15000); error: SF-Pricing-00006 StampBaseFilter#1 / SF-BRE-00004 on all fresh cancel lines
defectStep: StampBaseFilter (parent step StampContributorBasePreDiscount): criterion #5 is 'NetUnitPrice GreaterThan 0' with no IsNotNull guard. Condition logic '(1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5' fails at evaluation because the rules engine cannot evaluate GreaterThan on a null NetUnitPrice (SF-BRE-00004). The reprice aborts before CancelLineCreditPosthook can seed the credit from CancelNetUnitPrice__c.
proposedFix: Add an IsNotNull guard on criterion #5 of StampBaseFilter: change condition logic from '(1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5' to '(1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND (5 OR NetUnitPrice_IsNull_Guard)' where the guard is 'NetUnitPrice IsNull'. Alternatively, reorder the criteria so cancel lines are excluded via QuoteTypeText__c/OrderType before NetUnitPrice is evaluated, or set NetUnitPrice to 0 (rather than null) at line creation so the existing GreaterThan test evaluates correctly. Active design 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY — in-place edit only, no new version.
notes: Defect persists unchanged in V21 as of 2026-06-30 in-place edit. Discriminant is null vs non-null NetUnitPrice: fresh Apex-inserted cancel lines (NetUnitPrice=null) all fail; pre-priced lines (NetUnitPrice > 0) pass StampBaseFilter and CancelLineCreditPosthook correctly outputs TotalPrice=net*qty. Preflight passed: product Services type, PBE active in Fortra Price Book (list=15000, USD), CancelNetUnitPrice__c=15000 seeded from pbe.UnitPrice fallback (asset has no AssetActionSource), QuoteTypeText__c=Cancellation, Qty=-1. K-08 derived-cancel (NetUnitPrice=71 pre-set) also reprices to TotalPrice=-71 confirming posthook works. Control quote 0Q0WC000003EQtl0AG verified passing with V21 active version 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY.
verdict_reason: Preflight passed on valid cancel fixture (CancelNetUnitPrice__c=15000, Qty=-1, QuoteTypeText__c=Cancellation, active PBE USD list=15000). Force-reprice through V21 fails with SF-BRE-00004 at StampBaseFilter#1 because NetUnitPrice=null on fresh cancel lines. Control line with NetUnitPrice pre-set=15000 passes and produces correct TotalPrice=-15000. Root cause is a null-unsafe criterion in StampBaseFilter that aborts the entire pricing calculation before the CancelLineCreditPosthook can execute. This is a PROCEDURE-DEFECT (not a fixture artifact): the procedure must handle null NetUnitPrice on cancel lines because fresh cancel lines legitimately have no prior NetUnitPrice value — the whole point of CancelNetUnitPrice__c+the posthook is to seed it.
